about.heading: About the human
about.quote: Currently procrastinating on: finishing this website. Previously procrastinated on: starting this website.
paragraphs: I’m a CS student (the indecisive kind) currently based in my bed Bangalore, India. I’m into servers, self-hosting, the open web, and breaking things that were working fine.
Full stack, DevOps or forward deployed engineering: I haven’t picked one yet, so for now I do a bit of each.
